units.source_text: 我心中为鹤川服丧将近一年。

en.t: In my heart, I mourned Tsurukawa for nearly a year.

units.source_text: 我一旦开始了孤独的生活，很容易就习惯了，

en.t: Once I began living in solitude, I grew used to it very easily,

units.source_text: 几乎和谁都是噤若寒蝉，我重新懂得：

en.t: and I was almost silent with everyone; I came to understand again:

units.source_text: 对我来说，这种生活是最不需要努力就能达到的。

en.t: for me, this kind of life was the one I could reach with the least effort.

units.source_text: 我也失去了对生的焦灼。

en.t: I also lost my anxious impatience toward life.

units.source_text: 逝去的每一天都是非常愉快的。

en.t: Each passing day was extremely pleasant.
